displayName: WinsPool kickoff queue task attempts failing

documentation.content: Cloud Tasks is getting non-OK responses from the Cloud Run Jobs API while dispatching winspool-kickoff-triggers tasks (sync, predict, resimulate). The most likely causes are IAM (the winspool-scheduler account needs roles/run.invoker AND roles/run.jobsExecutorWithOverrides on winspool-predict-daily; the resimulate task overrides container args) or a deleted/renamed job. Inspect with: gcloud tasks list --queue=winspool-kickoff-triggers --location=us-east1 --project=fishbone-wins-pool
